% Table colors as in the PDF: alternating rows from \rowcolors (xcolor's
% table option), with colortbl loaded before xcolor, as some documents do;
% \cellcolor, \rowcolor (also in the HTML model), and \columncolor; a
% \multicolumn in a colored row; and \rowcolors with its command for each
% row ([\hline]) left out, under a \cellcolor and a \rowcolor.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}
\definecolor{ink}{RGB}{200,0,100}
\begin{document}
{\rowcolors{1}{red!10}{blue!10}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
a & b \\
c & d \\
e & f \\
\end{tabular}}

{\rowcolors{2}{}{green!10}
\begin{tabular}{l}
h \\ i \\ j \\ k \\ l \\
\end{tabular}}

\begin{tabular}{>{\columncolor{green!20}}ll}
one & two \\
three & four \\
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
\rowcolor[HTML]{DDEEFF} five & \textcolor{ink}{six} \\
\cellcolor{ink!25} seven & eight \\
\end{tabular}

\begin{tabular}{cc}
\multicolumn{2}{c}{\cellcolor{ink!25}head} \\
\rowcolor{green!25}\multicolumn{2}{c}{x} \\
\end{tabular}

{\rowcolors[\hline]{1}{red!10}{blue!10}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
a & \cellcolor{yellow} b \\
\rowcolor{green} c & d \\
\end{tabular}}
\end{document}
